catalog.agent_visibility: Complete raw materials, answers and references may be selected for an Environment; the developer controls their use.
catalog.container_strategy: Prepare on the trusted controller. Use a compatible dev environment for builds; target receives only admitted prebuilt programs and inputs. This reference entry does not install an executable capability.
catalog.purpose: Reference artifact metadata, cache identities and reproducible experiment workflows; selectively import useful recipes instead of coupling the core API to a second orchestration framework.
qualification_gaps: Catalogued research candidate; a source pin does not establish complete acquisition, dependency closure or native execution.
Complete materials may be selected for an Environment; experiment visibility is chosen by the developer.

Archive URL is derived from the resolved repository commit; payload SHA-256 and exact bytes remain unresolved until explicit acquisition/import.
The pinned official README labels CK/CM/CMX legacy and identifies a successor; pin the intended generation and API explicitly.
The framework is not itself a native compiler benchmark corpus and does not establish workload correctness.
Many general recipes acquire external dependencies or models; resolve only selected non-model compiler workloads during preparation.
Existing project manifests and measurement protocols remain authoritative; recipe execution must not silently alter frozen materials.
catalog.size_basis: Unacquired payload and installed footprint remain null; reference metadata bytes are not dataset size.

notes: The original complete archive is copied independently into each environment; no original file or link is omitted or rewritten.

Original id, version, provider, target, sources, dependencies, catalog facts and license notices remain unchanged.
